fieldData.excerpt: This guide covers everything you need to start earning points for the Radix Rewards 1B XRD campaign, by trading on Ociswap.
fieldData.main-content:
This content is for educational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice. Always do your own research before making any trading decisions.

The Radix Rewards Campaign is live, and one of the easiest ways to start earning Activity Points is by trading on Ociswap, one of Radix's premier DEX platforms. This tutorial will walk you through exactly how to trade on the supported pairs that earn you points and your share of 1b $XRD.

What You'll Need

Before you start trading, make sure you have:

  • Radix Wallet downloaded and set up (get it here)
  • XRD tokens for transaction fees 
  • Tokens to trade - any of the supported assets such as hUSDC, hUSDT, hETH, hWBTC, or XRD
  • Enrolled accounts in the Radix Rewards program
  • Minimum $50 worth of XRD/LSU holdings across all linked accounts

‍

Supported Trading Pairs That Earn Points

Not all trading earns incentive points! You'll earn Activity Points (AP) when you trade assets via supported pools. For example:

  • hUSDC <> XRD
  • hBTC <> hUSDC
  • xUSDT <> XRD
  • EARLY <> XRD
  • and more! Always check the "Earn" page of the Radix Rewards Dashboard

‍

Step-by-Step Trading Guide

Step 1: Access Ociswap

  1. Go to ociswap.com
  2. Connect your Radix Wallet using the "Connect Wallet" button
  3. Approve the connection in your mobile wallet

‍

‍

Step 2: Navigate to the Swap Feature

  1. On the main dashboard, locate the Swap feature on the right-hand side (ociswap.com/swap on mobile)
  2. You'll see two dropdown menus - one for the token you're selling ("From") and one for the token you're buying ("To")

‍

Step 3: Select Your Trading Pair

Choose one of the supported pairs. For example:

  • For hUSDC/XRD trading: Select USDC in one field and XRD in the other
  • For hUSDT/XRD trading: Select USDT in one field and XRD in the other
  • For hETH/XRD trading: Select ETH in one field and XRD in the other
  • For hWBTC/XRD trading: Select WBTC in one field and XRD in the other

‍

Tip: Click the dropdown arrow next to each token to browse the full list of available tokens.

‍

Step 4: Enter Your Trade Amount

  1. Input the amount you want to trade in the "From" field
  2. The "To" field will automatically calculate how much you'll receive
  3. Check the "You will receive at least" section to confirm you're satisfied with the rate
  4. Review any price impact warnings for larger trades

‍

Step 5: Execute Your Trade

  1. Click "Swap Tokens"
  2. Review the transaction details in your Radix Wallet
  3. Approve the transaction in your mobile wallet
  4. Wait for the transaction to confirm

‍

‍

Step 6: Verify Your Trade

  • Check your Radix Wallet to confirm you received your new tokens
  • Your trading activity will automatically generate Activity Points in the incentives system

‍

Pro Trading Tips for Maximum Points

Trade Regularly: Points are earned based on your weekly trading activity, so consistent trading may be more beneficial than one large trade.

Monitor Your Rankings: Remember that Activity Points convert to Season Points based on your weekly ranking compared to other traders in the same category.

Use the Advanced Chart View: Scroll down on Ociswap's main page to access detailed price charts for technical analysis before making trades.

Watch for Arbitrage Opportunities: Price differences between the supported pairs can create profitable trading opportunities while earning points.

‍

How Points Are Earned from Trading

When you trade in the supported pairs, you earn Activity Points based on your trading volume. Here's a simplified breakdown:

Week 1: You trade → Earn Activity Points (AP)
Week 2: Your AP gets converted to Season Points (SP) based on your ranking vs other traders
Week 3: Your SP gets multiplied by your XRD/LSU holding bonus (0.5x to 3x)

For a detailed explanation of how the point system works, check out our complete guide: https://www.radixdlt.com/blog/eli5-how-you-earn-points-for-the-1bn-xrd-airdrop-in-the-radix-incentives-campaign 

‍

Important Reminders

  • Enroll First: Make sure you've enrolled in the Radix Rewards program and linked your trading accounts
  • Minimum Holdings: You need at least $50 worth of XRD/LSU across all linked accounts to start earning points
  • Supported Pairs Only: Only the pairs listed the earn tab of the Radix Rewards dashboard are counted towards your points on Ociswap
  • Weekly Rankings: Points are calculated weekly, so consistent activity matters

‍

Next Steps

Now that you know how to trade for incentive points, consider exploring:

  • Providing Liquidity on Ociswap or other DEXs for supported pairs
  • Lending on Root or WEFT for additional point categories
  • Exploring other Radix dApps that participate in the Radix Rewards program

‍

Ready to start earning points? Head over to Ociswap and begin trading in the supported pairs. Remember to trade responsibly and within your risk tolerance.

Have questions about Ociswap? Join their Telegram community or follow them on X.

‍
